column2: Mum, smashed handset. I'm on a borrowed SIM. Could you cover this payment for me now? Can't take calls.
Papa I lost my mobile. Settle this bill using the account below please. It's urgent and private.
Your niece needs emergency cash. Do not contact her parents. Send it to my wallet immediately.
I am the college finance officer. Pay examination charges into my private account today.
Your placement officer here. Send a refundable verification payment to secure this offer.
The director needs shopping vouchers for a confidential task. Send me their redemption numbers.
Security desk here. Please read out the SMS passcode so we can stop an unauthorized debit.
Account access is suspended until you disclose your login credentials to this support agent.
Confirm your banking secret PIN by replying to prevent your account from closing.
An instant loan awaits you. Send the insurance charge before the funds can be credited.
You have won a festival reward. Deposit a clearance payment to release your winnings.
Our firm picked you for a remote role. Transfer equipment charges before joining.
Work from home for daily profit. Top up your task wallet first to unlock withdrawals.

Your package has a wrong address. Enter bank card information on parcel-fix.example to reschedule.
Your vehicle faces seizure. Clear the penalty today using the link sent by this number.

To receive your refund, accept the UPI collect request and type your PIN.
Install the app I sent and grant remote access. I'll fix your bank refund from my computer.

I can get your hacked account back. Send your current password and login code to me.
Your mobile service will stop. Give the caller your SIM verification SMS code.

The landlord is overseas. Pay the deposit before seeing the flat. I cannot arrange a visit.
Your college admission will lapse in an hour. Transfer a seat reservation fee to this UPI ID.
Unclaimed tax refund. Reply with your banking password and account code to get the credit.
Our recovery team found your lost cryptocurrency. Pay the release charge and share your seed phrase.
Urgent request from your boss. Buy prepaid vouchers and send their codes before our meeting.
My charger broke, so my phone is off. I'll talk to you at home tonight.
The new class representative will introduce herself during tomorrow's lecture.
Your brother asked me to tell you he'll be late for dinner. Call him on the number you have.
Tuition is due next week. Confirm the amount at the college counter before paying.
The placement cell says no employer should ask you for a joining deposit.
Our manager wants us to discuss gift card fraud at the next security training.
If a caller requests your SMS code, hang up. Contact the bank using its official app.
This newsletter explains why a password request in a message is a warning sign.
No bank agent needs your PIN to issue a refund. Keep your codes to yourself.
You can apply for a student loan by visiting the bank. Compare the charges first.
The prize ceremony is on Friday. Winners receive their certificates at the auditorium.
A recruiter invited me to an interview at the office. I will verify their details first.
The internship has no fees. An official email will explain the onboarding schedule.
I withdrew my balance yesterday and the receipt is in my bank app.
The finance lecture covers crypto risks and warns that guaranteed returns are suspicious.
The courier left a delivery notice at the door. Check the order in your shopping app.
Police are running a public awareness event about fake arrest calls at the community hall.
Our professor will explain digital arrest fraud and why callers must be verified.
The utility company has updated its office hours on its official website.
A refund returned to my original account today. I didn't have to approve a collect request.
IT staff will meet me at the help desk. I won't give remote access to strangers.
My friend was threatened by a caller yesterday. We saved the messages for a complaint.
Account recovery instructions are inside the official app. Keep all login codes private.
I changed my SIM at the network provider's shop and checked the receipt.
My roommate needs help moving boxes. Meet us at the hostel entrance after class.
We visited the flat together and will review the rental contract before paying a deposit.
The admissions office accepts payments through its published portal after document review.
This article describes fake tax refunds. Avoid sharing banking secrets with callers.
The cybersecurity assignment asks us to analyze scam messages using fictional data.
Please buy groceries on the way home. We can settle our usual shared expenses at dinner.
